extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee but accepted it on the advice of the Superintendent and Farmer, who told her that if she did not take it and pay the taxes that she would lose the land and get nothing for it

extraction.NOTES: mentally competent and in fair health; has two children depending on her for support; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since she was granted a patent; states she will have her land back if the Department cancels the patent; document number 358; affidavit sworn November 28, 1928 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County (South Dakota)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
